subject: mth
title: (R)MTH.------RE.ST.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(I)-18. The prose preceding (MP(I)-17) establishes Braxton's claim about the Coltrane/King 'center platform': 'the realness of John Coltrane's activity and Dr. Martin Luther King's activity solidified the same vibrational position with respect to what it posed for alternative functionalism' — and the prose immediately following declares 'there is another route just as important, and the realness it implies has also affected the composite reality of things.' The crossing names that other route: (R)MTH (the reality of methodology) is crossed with RE-ST (restructuralism — the form-rebuilding that route produces). MTH sits at the lower-left with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY (information dynamics) rises from the main line, IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) branches left from INFO-DY, and RT-DY (reality dynamics) hangs from IF-SPT. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) descends from the main line, and INFO-INTR (information interpretation) branches from AF-DY. RE-ST is partner-axis at upper-right. IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) branches right from the main line; (R)INT (the reality of intention) descends from IST-S-ALGN, MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from (R)INT, and PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) branches from MT-INFO.
